topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: It seems the neighbor has taken a liking to the idea of borders, boundaries, defined spaces. A fence, they say, will enhance privacy, perhaps even security. It’s a peculiar notion, considering the longstanding openness between our properties, a silent agreement upheld by mutual respect and the occasional shared conversation over the hedge. Now, this proposal of wood and nails, it stands as a suggestion of what might change. It’s curious how a simple structure can redefine years of unspoken understanding. The world feels a bit smaller, somehow, just at the mention. Yet, it’s their decision, and I suppose change, like fences, can be as inevitable as they are dividing.
